thesis: Pure-play 'green metals' producer focused on copper and zinc after the 2024 divestiture of its steelmaking-coal business to Glencore. Q2 2026 was a record quarter — adjusted EBITDA roughly tripled YoY to ~$2.2B on record copper prices and higher production — and the pending 'merger of equals' with Anglo American (Anglo Teck) would create a top-five global copper producer with ~$800M in annual synergies. After a ~23% run to ~$59.75, however, the stock trades ABOVE the blended analyst consensus 12-month target (~$53.23) with a Hold consensus label, so near-term risk/reward is balanced even as the longer-term copper supercycle and merger bull case remain intact.

financials.cash: fortress balance sheet (net cash post-coal sale)

drivers: Record copper prices persist on a structural supply deficit fed by electrification, grid buildout, and AI data-center power demand
Anglo Teck merger closes on schedule, delivering ~$800M annual synergies and top-five global copper scale
QB2 (Quebrada Blanca) in Chile ramps toward higher output and Highland Valley mine-life extension advances
Reaffirmed 2026-2028 production guidance is met or exceeded
Copper supercycle narrative drives sector multiple re-rating

base_case.assumptions: Copper prices moderate from record highs but remain healthy; QB2 and Highland Valley continue ramping per reaffirmed 2026-2028 guidance; Anglo Teck merger closes with normal execution and synergies realized over time; balanced near-term risk/reward with the stock near fair value.

risks: Copper prices correct sharply on a China demand slowdown or global recession
Anglo Teck merger faces regulatory delays, conditions, or fails to close
Chile political, royalty, or permitting risk pressures margins and project economics
QB2 / Highland Valley production ramp disappoints versus guidance
Post-run valuation compresses as the stock sits above consensus target

catalysts.event: Q3 2026 earnings — read on copper realizations, production, and cash generation
Anglo Teck merger regulatory approvals and close — central transformational catalyst
QB2 (Quebrada Blanca) and Highland Valley Copper production ramp toward reaffirmed 2026-2028 guidance
Copper price / LME moves — key swing factor for earnings and sentiment

key_risks: Valuation: stock trades above the blended consensus 12-month target after a ~23% run
Copper price cyclicality and high correlation to China demand
Anglo Teck merger execution and regulatory approval risk
Chile political risk — royalty increases, permitting, regulatory changes
Merger integration complexity with Anglo American
